nom: fresh Kombucha Antioxidant Facial Treatment Essence

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin used it before cleansing and found it helped lift dirt and left her face feeling clean rather than heavier.
segments.dry: Several reviewers describe dry, very dry, or dry-high-altitude skin and report the essence relieves tightness and dullness and adds moisture that regular moisturizers didn't achieve alone.
segments.combination: One reviewer with lifelong combination skin says it is moisturizing without being greasy and has replaced pricier alternatives including SK-II.
segments.sensitive: One reviewer flags heavy fragrance as something sensitive skin should be cautious of, and another with sensitivity reports new pimples, redness and an allergic-feeling reaction.
segments.mature: A 70-year-old reviewer and another noting people don't believe her age both describe visibly improved, softer, younger-looking skin with regular use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers report a brighter, more youthful, resurfaced look and compliments on their age; one mature user calls it one of the best products she's used at 70.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority describe relief from dryness and tightness, plumping, and lasting hydration, including in dry climates or winter conditions; no dissent reported.
concerns.redness: One reviewer says it evened out dark patches and discoloration, while another reports the product made her face turn red and irritated.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers in dry or harsh climates (high altitude, cold transit work, tropical humidity) say it restored comfort and moisture balance where other moisturizers sat on top of skin; no negative reports on barrier function specifically.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with hyperpigmentation and occasional hormonal breakouts reports her skin looks its best in years and pigmentation improved; no dissent noted for spots specifically.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report fewer breakouts, whiteheads resolving, or acne staying under control; one reviewer reports new pimples and an allergic reaction after use.
concerns.oiliness: A single reviewer with oily skin reports it helped remove daily buildup and left her face feeling clean rather than greasy; no other oily-skin feedback given.

aspects.libelle: Good value over time despite cost
Can cause moisturizer to pill if overused

extraits.titre: I would not buy this again
extraits.texte: I have gotten this as a sample before. I had used it and noticed my skin looked almost glossy and was happy about that. I had used it for a couple of days and notice new pimples appearing and noticed I was allergic to it. It also was harsh on my skin. It also madd my face look red.I personally would nog recommend this.
Love this treatment. I use it as a moisturizer for my very dry skin. It's excellent whereas many true moisturizers sit on the top of my skin and don't get absorbed. I'm hooked! My skin looks nice.

I had a sample of this through Sephora last summer and I took it to Jamaica with me for vacation. My skin was amazing...and I chalked it up to the Jamaican breeze. This spring I noticed my skin was really dull. I have issues with hyperpigmentation and an occasional hormonal breakdown. Since I have been using this, as well as other fresh products my skin has not looked this good in years. Youthful, bright, and hardly any pimples. A little bit goes a long way! I use 3-4 drops and pat it into my skin after a wash and toner.

I have combo skin all my life, and so finding a product that is moisturizing and non-greasey is the key. This product is a life changer! It is more than a standard toner as it helps my serum/moisturizer absorbs much better while providing a healthy glass skin glow. I have tried other cheaper alternative or even SK-II, and i have always come back to this product at the end. Highly recommend!

For reference, skin is deep and dry. I stop using Kombucha for one week and noticed my skin reverting back to dull and dry. I started using it again and my skin is radiant and hydrated. I use before my moisturizer in the morning and at night. My only complaint is the cost, however, I love that Fresh has option to buy the Mini.

extraits.titre: I didnt think I needed this but its wonderful
extraits.texte: Using this before washing my face or when i only used this without washing my face for just to combat my oily skin helped my face feel clean. The cotton pad also showed this product is working to get any dirt or everyday exposure off my face before doing any other cleansing.

I'm 70 and my skin has never looked better. This is one of the loveliest products I've ever used and believe me I've probably used most everything out there. It literally feeds my skin to a soft sheen. I plan on using this from now on.
